items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 140:1
items.html: Before the sin, the First Man had NRN from the BYA of Atzilut. And after the sin, the nine upper [Sefirot] of the lights of each and every Sefira of his NRN of Atzilut departed from him, together with the nine lower [Sefirot] of the vessels of each Sefira of the NRN, and there remained in him only the lights of the Nefashot of each Sefira and the vessels of the crowns of each Sefira. And even these were not from the aspect of Atzilut, but from BYA, below the Parsa, for the BYA were blemished because of his sin and descended below the Parsa of Atzilut. And the matter of the remaining of the crowns of the vessels and the lights of the Nefashot is by reason of the inverse value between the vessels and the lights: for as long as there is in him only the vessel of the crown, only the smallest light, which is the light of the Nefesh, can clothe in it, as is known. (Item 125).
